task_description: Reach full Playwright MCP tool-surface parity in laya-browser-mcp (all CORE + network/storage/testing/devtools/pdf/vision/config groups, capability-gated), add cross-browser (chromium/firefox/webkit) support driven from config, and broaden the Autopilot (Laya) decision loop to drive the richer toolset FASTER (batch fill_form + hover/navigate_back/press_key/screenshot/verify), keeping graceful no-weights degradation and an offline vitest suite with literal per-tool assertions. Preserve the existing laya_run_goal Autopilot tool. Commit locally; do not push.

verification.summary: typecheck clean, build emits dist, vitest 137 passed / 3 skipped (3 skips: real-weights Autopilot gated on LAYA_MODEL_DIR; WebKit gated on inability to launch in this sandbox for missing shared libs). 71 Assist tools + laya_run_goal registered, matching README tables. Test quality verified: new tests drive real headless Chromium against local loopback fixtures and assert literal DOM/transcript outcomes (input values, status text, mocked-route JSON, offline-fetch rejection, scrollY, step counts, source breakdown) that fail if a tool returns undefined. bench green (login-multi 3 steps via one FILL_FORM batch, rule/laya/stub/llm = 3/0/0/0). No Dockerfile in repo, so docker build not applicable. Semantic review APPROVED (v1 then v2 after two non-blocking fixes committed in db6cc2f).

review.notes: v1 findings 1 (config-parsed-once) and 2 (FILL_FORM on escalation) fixed in db6cc2f and re-verified in v2. Findings 3 (session-level runCode gating) and 4 (DEVTOOLS honest no-ops return isError:false, documented) accepted as low-risk and left as-is.
